ov: A seagrass-eating marine mammal of the Indo-West Pacific, the manatee’s relative and the only living member of its family. Its closest relative, Steller’s sea cow, was hunted to extinction in the 1700s.

why.et: Hunted for thousands of years for meat and oil, and traditional hunting still matters culturally.

rg: Coastal waters of some 40 countries across the Indian Ocean and western Pacific.

cf.tip: Dugongs and manatees are the four living sirenians; the dugong lives in the Indo-West Pacific.

fx: Feeding trails have been seen as deep as 33 m.
